notes.title: Cosplay Collection v1.28 Update
notes.notes:
Add
New Scene Dragon's Lair
Characters can now move around the scene
The character menu has been changed to avatars to simplify the space and make it easier to add more characters in the future.

Change
The WASD keys are now changed to character movement, and the camera pan is now the middle mouse button.
Space key can jump

Add:
Save Function
There are Save and Load functions in the lower right corner of the screen. After configuring the style you like, press Save to save it. When you restart the game next time, press Load to load the last saved style.

Information that can be saved:
clothing, pantyhose, skin color, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, eyelashes, head ratio, soft body, H volume
Information that cannot be saved:
Breast, calves, face shape
